subject.title: feat(ui): permanent OpenClaw presence — pinned sidebar entry and Settings dock

question: After the mode-transition repair and runtime evidence are provided, should Phase 6’s default-pinned OpenClaw entry and Settings deep link be accepted as the intended fresh-profile navigation behavior?
rationale: The implementation follows a stated onboarding redesign phase, but the protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit human decision on the final product behavior after the mechanical correctness and proof gates are satisfied.

options.title: Accept after repair and proof
options.body: Keep the fresh-profile default pin and Settings entry once mode changes start a correct conversation and redacted live evidence demonstrates both routes.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Retain the normal workspace entry but defer the Settings entry or default pin if the permanent-presence navigation policy should be smaller.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair and proof
recommendation.body: Keep the fresh-profile default pin and Settings entry once mode changes start a correct conversation and redacted live evidence demonstrates both routes.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged and current feature history connects this person to the custodian onboarding and permanent-presence design.
